references.text: The burnt offering was to be a flawless bull, here referred to as a young bull for the burnt offering
A ram is mentioned as a burnt offering, corresponding to the one ram brought here
A one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering, the same specification as the lamb mentioned in this verse
One-year-old lambs are mentioned as the daily burnt offering, with the same age requirement as here
Identical wording regarding the burnt offering from Nahshon's offering on the first day
The same burnt offering from Nethanel's offering on the second day
Young bulls, rams, and one-year-old lambs are mentioned together as burnt offerings for the festival sacrifice
